profile.signOutMessage: Your backlog stays saved in your account. Sign in again to pick up where you left off.
profile.deleteMessage:
Your backlog and ratings will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.

Deleting your account doesn't cancel a Barklog Premium subscription. Cancel it in your App Store subscriptions.
profile.deleteFailedMessage: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
profile.reverifyMessage: For your security, sign in again before deleting your account. In your account, open Security, then Delete account.
profile.feedbackFooter: Suggest a feature or report a problem. I read every message.
